layerDefinitions.data: the dataset, artefact or documented assumption the calculation reads
layerDefinitions.method: the model or closed-form calculation itself
layerDefinitions.service: the backend module that assembles the result
layerDefinitions.endpoint: the HTTP route a client calls
layerDefinitions.inputCheck: request validation that rejects impossible inputs
layerDefinitions.outputCheck: validation that the result is coherent, or a stated absence
layerDefinitions.uncertainty: a quantified spread, or an explicit statement that none exists
layerDefinitions.provenance: the sources and their limits travel with the answer
layerDefinitions.frontend: a screen a user can reach and read

workflows.title: Water demand and irrigation scheduling
workflows.answers: How much water does this canopy want today, and what happens if it is irrigated on this schedule?
workflows.phase29Change: an FAO-56 soil water balance added to the existing demand calculation: depletion, stress coefficient, deep percolation, stress days and an irrigation volume, all optional and all labelled as a reference calculation
whatItDoesNotDo: convert a transpiration deficit into a yield loss: that needs a crop yield-response factor this repository does not hold
extrapolate the measured lettuce bench to tomato or radish: the study measured lettuce
forecast weather: the schedule repeats the supplied single day across the cycle

workflows.title: Crop growth and harvest prediction
workflows.answers: What fresh mass per square metre does the served model predict from this DLI and environment, and how much should that number be trusted?
workflows.phase30Change: the forecast was removed. A leave-one-study-out evaluation over 53 published treatment means from 40 studies returned 310.17 % MAPE against the unchanged 30 % criterion, with the mean baseline selected out of fold; the sealed Phase 28 holdout had already returned 41.59 %. POST /api/workflows/harvest-prediction/run is now a 410 tombstone and the catalogue entry is 'unavailable'. Only the measured-versus-model parity record and the decision record remain readable.
workflows.phase29Change: the served model was re-examined rather than replaced: the pipeline was audited, six candidates were scored on identical grouped folds, and the winner was taken to the holdout once. It failed the unchanged 30 % criterion at 39.28 % MAPE, so v3 stays in service and no v4 artefact exists.
whatItDoesNotDo: forecast: the independent holdout failed and the response says so above the number
generalise outside the four training experiments: per-experiment bias runs from -635 to +505 g/m2
guarantee interval coverage on a new site: the pooled out-of-fold 0.899 is descriptive, and coverage by experiment falls to 0.696 in EXP3

workflows.title: Light quality and environmental stress
workflows.answers: Under this spectral regime, what did the plants actually weigh and how did their photosystems behave?
workflows.phase29Change: new workflow: a measured comparison over four spectral regimes
whatItDoesNotDo: predict anything: there is no model on this path, by design
respond to PPFD, photoperiod, CO2, temperature or humidity: the experiment held them constant, so no control exists to move
separate spectrum from density in t3: that regime changes both
compute a composite stress score: the indices are reported side by side

features.claim: Predicted crop water use in litres per plant per day
features.phase29: unchanged; an irrigation schedule now sits on top of the demand calculation, and the bench is still one lettuce study

features.claim: The ET0 target is itself correct
features.phase29: unchanged; no new independent ET0 source was acquired
the generalisation attempt failed: holdout MAPE 39.28 % against a 30 % criterion, so the tier did not move and the failure is recorded

features.claim: Response to specific LED spectra and photoperiods
features.phase29: moved from experimental to research-ready for the comparison only: a measured four-regime workflow now exists with intervals, tests and verified provenance. The response surface is still absent, and photoperiod still has no data.

unchanged; the new workflow is single-cultivar (Red Batavia)

blocked.capability: A continuous response surface in spectral composition, PPFD, photoperiod, CO2, temperature or humidity
blocked.blockedBy: no open dataset varies any of these over a yield response in lettuce; the search that established this is data/research/phase29/environmental_stress_search.json
blocked.consequence: the workflow offers four named measured regimes and marks every other environmental factor as unsupported, in the response as well as in the UI

blocked.capability: Growth or yield under lunar or Martian gravity
blocked.blockedBy: no fractional-gravity crop dataset exists in any open repository
blocked.consequence: the simulator refuses the claim and the factor remains data-blocked

blocked.capability: Converting an irrigation deficit into a yield loss
blocked.blockedBy: no crop yield-response factor (Ky) exists in this repository
blocked.consequence: the irrigation schedule reports stress days and a relative transpiration deficit, and explicitly declines the conversion
